ACTIVATED_ABILITY.TARGET_DEFINITION: local filter = ClearFilter() filter:Add( FE_TYPE, OP_IS, CARD_TYPE_CREATURE )
ACTIVATED_ABILITY.RESOLUTION_TIME_ACTION: local filter = ClearFilter() filter:Add( FE_TYPE, OP_IS, CARD_TYPE_CREATURE) filter:Add( FE_CONTROLLER, OP_IS, EffectController() ) local number = filter:Count() EffectDC():Set_Int(1, number)
ACTIVATED_ABILITY.CONTINUOUS_ACTION: local target = EffectDC():Get_Targets(0):Get_CardPtr(0) local number = EffectDC():Get_Int(1) if target ~= nil and number ~= 0 then local characteristics = target:GetCurrentCharacteristics() characteristics:Power_Add( number ) characteristics:Toughness_Add( number ) end
